title: CaseBlitz '26
description: Official flagship 24-hour business and product case-solving challenge organized by Product Management Club & 180 Degrees Consulting. Teams analyze real-world market disruption problems and deliver strategic pitches to industry judges.

title: Grand Inauguration & Fest Overview
description:
The official grand opening of Concetto'26 Centenary Edition.

INTERNAL TIMELINE:
• 04:00 PM – 05:00 PM: Chief / Guest Arrival
• 05:00 PM – 06:00 PM: INAUGURATION & Lamp Lighting
• 06:00 PM – 07:00 PM: Welcome Address + Director / Chief Guest
• 07:00 PM – 08:00 PM: Concetto Introduction + Fest Overview

title: QuesTree ’26
description: Finance, analytics, and business acumen quiz hosted by Fintech Club testing economic intuition and data interpretation.

title: Mathalon
description: The competition will cover topics such as basic logic, probability, geometry, number theory, recurrence relations, basic calculus, and other fundamental areas of mathematics, with emphasis on numerical problem-solving rather than lengthy proofs.

title: Campus Treasure Hunt Challenge
description: Campus-wide treasure hunt cracking geographical clues, campus trivia, and secret riddles scattered across heritage landmarks of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

title: VibeHack ’26 (DevDash)
description: DevDash is a beginner-friendly web development hackathon in which teams receive a surprise challenge and rapidly turn it into a creative, functional and presentable website, promoting creativity, teamwork, problem-solving and practical development skills.

title: Game Zone — Team Arena Challenges
description: Interactive gaming hub with console stations, multiplayer VR battles, mini arcade tournaments, and crowd challenges open all day.

title: Code The Cosmos
description: Astrophysical simulation and orbital mechanics programming competition organized by Astronomy & Space Technology Club (ASTC).

title: Aethera
description: Aethera is a national sustainability case competition by SESE, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. Teams of up to 3 tackle a live industry sustainability challenge across three rounds: an online screening test, a case deck submission, and The Boardroom, a live online finale where the top 10 teams pitch before an expert panel and face a surprise Curveball round.
organizerClub: Society of Environmental Science and Engineering (SESE)

title: Gate Craft
description: An exciting Minecraft-based technical competition where participants design and build digital logic circuits using Redstone. Participants are challenged to demonstrate logic, creativity, accuracy, and speed within a fixed time.

title: Keynote Guest Talk 1
description: Distinguished technical leadership lecture featuring renowned industrialists and engineering visionaries sharing perspectives on cutting-edge deep tech and national progress.

title: AeroGlide (Mechismu)
description: RC aircraft and UAV design competition. Teams build fixed-wing RC gliders tested on flight duration, payload delivery, aerodynamic efficiency, and spot-landing precision.

title: Archway Arena ’26
description: Structural truss and arch bridge loading challenge. Teams construct lightweight balsa/popsicle bridge arches tested against dynamic hydraulic point loads until failure.

title: ForkLift ’26
description: Smart contract security, DeFi protocol architecture, and Web3 dApp development hackathon. Teams audit vulnerable Solidity contracts and build decentralized products.

title: Quantum Mania
description: Quantum circuit design, teleportation protocol implementation, and quantum algorithm optimization using Qiskit and Pennylane.

title: Tech Visionary Guest Talk 2
description: Inspirational symposium on generative intelligence, autonomous robotics, and emerging computing paradigms shaping the next century.

title: Logic Odyssey
description: Logic Odyssey is a ZIO-style, pen-and-paper logic and problem-solving competition featuring 4–6 challenging questions. With 90 minutes to solve, participants will test their logical reasoning, mathematical thinking, analytical ability, and problem-solving skills.

title: Reservoir Making — IADC (Crack the Crude)
description: A two-round technical competition designed to test participants’ petroleum engineering knowledge, analytical thinking, and practical skills. The first round features a fast-paced petroleum-themed identification challenge where participants recognize equipment, geological formations, and industry concepts under time pressure. The top-performing teams advance to the second round, where they apply their understanding by designing and constructing a functional reservoir model to demonstrate concepts such as porosity, permeability, fluid migration, and hydrocarbon trapping.

title: CELEBRITY COMEDY NIGHT
description: Star stand-up comedy performance bringing India's top standup comedian live on stage for an evening of side-splitting laughter and satire. Entry begins at 7:00 PM.

title: TiNAS ’26
description: Flagship 24-hour jeopardy and attack-defense Capture The Flag tournament covering binary exploitation, reverse engineering, web security, cryptography, and forensics.

title: Sparkathon 2.0
description: Sparkathon is an innovation-oriented technical event that encourages participants to develop creative and practical solutions to real-world engineering problems. Participants will be required to analyze the given problem statement, formulate an innovative approach, and present their proposed solution to a panel.

title: Minute to Win It — Fast Reflex Games
description: Fast-paced 60-second table challenges, balance games, card towers, and reflex competitions with instant prizes.

title: Escape Room
description: Immersive logic and puzzle escape game where teams decode lock codes, discover hidden cryptographic keys, and break out within 45 minutes.

title: Edge AI Challenge
description: A team-based technical competition where participants develop, optimize, and deploy a lightweight AI model on resource-constrained embedded hardware. Teams are judged on accuracy, speed, resource efficiency, and successful edge deployment.

title: MLMTE Quiz Club Quiz
description: National technical quiz on mining machinery, mineral exploration, metallurgy, sustainable mineral extraction, and geological engineering.

title: Hands-on Tech Workshop
description: Industry-led practical developer masterclass focused on deploying production LLMs, fine-tuning lightweight models, and low-latency inference on GPUs.

title: AnGD 3D Animation
description: Then. Now. Next. is a 15-day 3D animation competition where participants bring their creativity to life through 3D modelling, animation, and visual storytelling based on a given theme. Showcase your technical and artistic skills and create something truly engaging for Concetto’26.

title: Industry Leader Guest Talk 1
description: Fireside conversation with global technology founders on scaling hardware startups, semiconductor manufacturing in India, and venture funding.

title: ChakraVyuh
description: Autonomous line-maze solving robot competition. Bots navigate multi-branched dynamic tracks with loops, line discontinuities, and obstacle avoidance.

title: ALCHEMIST
description: Chemical process optimization and reaction kinetics design sprint. Teams design an efficient separation column and simulate real refinery plant economics.

title: MECHISMU EXTREME BIKE STUNT SHOW
description: High-octane motorcycle acrobatic stunt show featuring professional riders executing burnouts, high-speed drifts, and wheelies on a custom stadium course.

title: ConvCup ’26
description: Machine learning Kaggle-style hackathon. Build predictive deep learning models for high-dimensional tabular, audio, or image classification datasets.

title: AutoNav
description: Autonomous vehicle and RC robotics competition featuring computer vision lane tracking, ultrasonic obstacle avoidance, and dynamic speed profiling.

title: Innovation Keynote Guest Talk 2
description: Keynote on Quantum Advantage, Artificial General Intelligence, and the role of engineering students in transforming Indian deep tech on the global stage.

title: Q-Blueprint
description: Quantum circuit optimization sprint. Create pulse-level schedules, implement error mitigation techniques, and benchmark quantum fidelity.

title: Equity Auction
description: Equity Auction is a high-stakes finance-simulation event where teams of 1-4 members take on the role of investors. Participants must navigate market uncertainty, execute strategic negotiations, and react dynamically to sudden market shocks.

title: MEGA EDM & DJ NIGHT
description: Centenary EDM celebration featuring top national electronic music artists, pyrotechnic displays, laser show, and massive open dance floors. Gathering starts at 7:00 PM.

title: Pixel Perfect ’26
description: Product redesign and design-system hackathon. Teams solve complex UX friction points and build high-fidelity interactive Figma prototypes judged on design thinking.

title: Seek the Civil Geek ’26
description: National civil engineering and structural aptitude quiz covering geotechnical mechanics, concrete technology, transportation systems, and surveying.

title: Fun Games Arena & Interactive Booths
description: All-day festival carnival featuring outdoor obstacle runs, giant board games, laser tag arenas, and photo booths across the festival concourse.

title: ROBO WARS — Combat Robotics Championship
description:
The undisputed colosseum of Concetto! Heavyweight custom combat robots clash in a reinforced polycarbonate cage until destruction or knockout.

INTERNAL TIMELINE:
• 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM: RoboWars — Main Rounds
• 05:00 PM – 06:00 PM: ROBO WARS — GRAND FINAL under stadium spotlights!

title: Next-Gen AI & Robotics Workshop
description: Expert-led intensive workshop on ROS2 (Robot Operating System), SLAM algorithms, and sensor fusion for autonomous mobile robots.

title: SBT Quiz
description: National biotechnology and life sciences quiz covering synthetic biology, genetic engineering, bioinformatics, and biomedical device innovations.

title: Fault Hunt
description: Fault Hunt is a circuit-analysis and troubleshooting-based technical event designed to test participants' understanding of electronic circuits, simulation, debugging, and analytical reasoning. The event will challenge participants to identify faults in circuits and justify their findings through systematic analysis.

title: AppSurD ’26
description: Mobile application development hackathon in Flutter, Android, or React Native building innovative offline-first mobile apps for real problems.

title: Futurist Keynote Guest Talk 1
description: Distinguished lecture on clean energy transition, sustainable mining practices, and geopolitical space exploration in the 21st century.

title: Code Wars
description: Code Wars is an ICPC-style competitive programming team contest where teams of exactly 3 participants solve algorithmic problems within 2.5–3 hours. The contest tests problem-solving, coding skills, algorithmic thinking, and teamwork.

title: SPE Event (Stand Tall - Jack Up Challenge)
description: Offshore rig design and structural integrity challenge testing stability, ocean current resistance, and drilling capability in offshore basins.

title: AutoExpo
description: Exhibition of custom fabricated student Formula racecars, electric ATVs, superbikes, modified vehicles, and exotic automotive engineering projects. Open entry for all spectators.

title: AnGD Game Jam (RRR-A Game Jam)
description: RRR – A Game Jam is a 9-day game development challenge where participants turn their ideas into playable games based on a surprise theme. Teams can use any game engine, experiment with gameplay and creativity, and present their final creation at Concetto’26.

title: Distinguished Alumni Guest Talk 2
description: Valedictory keynote address by prominent global IIT (ISM) alumni leaders reflecting on their journey from Dhanbad to leading multinational technology empires.

title: CELEBRITY STAR NIGHT (GRAND FINALE)
description:
The monumental finale of Concetto'26! Live in-concert performance by a top Bollywood / Indie headline artist. A colossal sensory experience with 10,000+ attendees, massive stage pyrotechnics, and unforgettable memories. Open entry with fest wristband.

INTERNAL TIMELINE:
• 06:30 PM – 07:30 PM: Star Night Preparation & Sound Check
• 07:30 PM – 08:00 PM: Star Night Gates Open & Entry
• 08:00 PM – 11:00 PM: STAR NIGHT LIVE IN-CONCERT

title: Prom Night '26 — Centenary Kickoff Gala
description: The signature formal celebration and pre-festival kickoff gala of Concetto'26 Centenary Edition. Dress in your finest evening wear for an enchanting night of acoustic performances, social networking, student spotlights, and celebrations before competitions begin.

title: Kryptoes '26 — Solo Dance Showdown
description: The premier solo dance face-off at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad organized by LITM (Legends In The Making). Freshers and campus dancers clash on stage across Hip Hop, Freestyle, Popping, Waacking, and Contemporary styles to crown the ultimate dance champion of Concetto!

title: Open Air Movie Night
description: Under the starlit sky of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, enjoy an open-air blockbuster movie screening with popcorn, giant projection, and pre-fest community fun.

title: Cancer Biology
description: Hands-on intensive masterclass exploring next-generation cancer therapeutics, CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing mechanisms, immunotherapy breakthroughs, and computational oncology tools. Certified workshop with clinical research demonstrations.

stages.name: Day 1: Cancer Genetics & CRISPR Foundations
stages.synopsis: CRISPR-Cas9 mechanisms and hands-on bioinformatics session.

stages.name: Day 2: Immunotherapy & Clinical Pipelines
stages.synopsis: Translational oncology and live gene analysis tools.

title: Generative & Agentic AI
description: Comprehensive hands-on workshop on building Autonomous Multi-Agent Workflows, Function Calling with Gemini 2.0 / LLMs, Vector Databases (RAG), and productionizing AI agents.

stages.name: Day 1: Multi-Agent Systems & Tool Calling
stages.synopsis: Agent architectures, tool calling with Gemini, and structured generation.

stages.name: Day 2: Autonomous Agents & Production Deployment
stages.synopsis: Memory indexing, vector search, and deploying live production agents.
